chunks: There will be the salutation by those of the right hand: "Peace on you."

key_terms.الْأَيْمَنِينَ: Those of the right hand; a term for the righteous who will receive their record of deeds in their right hand on the Day of Judgment.

ai.seo_question: Who greets the inhabitants of Paradise with peace according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this greeting from the 'Ahl al-Yamin' (People of the Right) underscores the communal joy of the righteous entering Paradise, reflecting the concept of *Tawassul* (seeking intercession/mediation) through the blessed. The phrase highlights the transition from the trials of the world to the eternal peace (*Salam*) granted by Allah, a theme central to the eschatological hopes of the faithful.
